QUESTION:
What conditions is Sertraline Hydrochloride indicated to treat?

RESPONSE:
Sertraline Hydrochloride is indicated to treat the following conditions in adults: 1) Major Depressive Disorder, 2) Obsessive-Compulsive Disorder (OCD), 3) Panic Disorder (with or without agoraphobia), 4) Posttraumatic Stress Disorder (PTSD), 5) Premenstrual Dysphoric Disorder (PMDD), and 6) Social Anxiety Disorder (also known as social phobia). Additionally, Sertraline Hydrochloride is indicated for the treatment of Obsessive-Compulsive Disorder in pediatric patients (children ages 6-12 and adolescents ages 13-17).
